entry.label: Practice: System Dynamics: build, calculate and challenge a queue model
entry.description: Distinguish causal-loop reasoning from an executable stock-flow model and verify a small model by hand. An original discrete-time stock-flow rehearsal with a deliberately simple boundary. It is not a prediction of a real service and does not validate a model merely because it runs.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.

Calculate the first four end-of-week backlogs.
Describe a balancing feedback that could generate the capacity decision.
Identify a missing mechanism that could reverse the policy conclusion.
